Experience the most complete racing ever with RIDE 3! Race on different tracks all over the world, put your favourite vehicles' speed to the test and have fun by customising them with the new Livery Editor.

notes.title: GUIDE: How to send a DXDiag file
notes.content:
In order to take better action to repair the errors/crashes of the game, we would like to be able to view the status of your PC through a DXDiag file.
Follow this guide to create one of them.

1. Press and hold the Windows key and the letter R on your keyboard
2. You will see a Run box in the lower-left corner of your screen
3. Type dxdiag in the text field
4. Click OK
-If your computer has a 64-bit version of Windows, click the button Run 64-bit DXDIAG
-If your computer has a 32-bit version of Windows, that button will not be available
5. Click the Save All Information button, found on the bottom of the DXDIAG report
6. Save this text file to your Desktop if possible and then attach it here

Thanks!

Milestone Team

notes.title: GUIDE: How to create a Dump file
notes.content:
Hello, to help us solve the game crashes on your PC, we ask you to follow these steps to create a Dump file.

Please make sure that you do what follows jsut after a crash, and leaving the windows pop up window related to crash open.

1. Press and hold the Windows key and the letter R on your keyboard
2. You will see a Run box in the lower-left corner of your screen
3. Type sysdm.cpl in the text field
4. Click OK
2.Click on the Advanced tab
3.Click on the Startup and Recovery Settings button
4.Ensure that Automatically restart is unchecked
5.Under the Write Debugging Information header select Small memory dump (256 kB) in the dropdown box
6.Ensure that the Small Dump Directory is listed as %systemroot%\Minidump << where your .dmp files can be found later
Click OK twice to exit the dialogs, then reboot for the changes to take effect.
7. Launch the game
8. Leave the error page open
9. Go to the task manager
10. Right click on the application (look for the name of the game)
11. Click on "Create Dump File"
12. Go to %systemroot%\Minidump
13. Take all the files, put them in a .zip folder and upload them here
If you have problems let us know and we'll help you.

If the file is bigger than 10mb upload it to Dropbox or Wetransfer and then link it here.

Thanks.

Milestone Team

notes.title: RIDE 3: new Patch released

We have read many of your requests, increasing our awareness of RIDE 3.
Thanks to you we have created the basis for the important upgrades that we have decided to play. The process of change will take some time, but we are pretty confident.
Today we start with these:

notes.title: RIDE 3: Full Track List Unveiled
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33657770/7b290f6fabd4649e195a8e12b4c1a90d2651ede1.gif

While creating RIDE 3, we knew two things for sure: being a biker means finding the right bike for your style and personality and explore the most breathtaking scenery of the world in all freedom.

That’s why we aimed at achieving the right balance between GP circuits, city and country tracks. Some of them, like Imola’s Autodromo in Italy, are reproductions of the real track, while others are a mix between fantasy and reality. Let’s take Macau, for example, with its awesome light effects and urban landscape: most of it has been created as a faithful reproduction of the track, while other parts are rethought from our game designers.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33657770/225078d318a84928f447898845606bd44e89ca4d.gif

If you want to feel completely one with the road, nothing is better than a country setting. RIDE 3 will offer you a wide choice of tracks in different locations and the real fun will be to try them all. In this way, each race will always have a different taste, for a very various gaming experience.

The life of a real biker is made up of many emotions and RIDE 3 will give you a lot to get excited. Enjoy all the tracks and start imagining which bike will take you to the next adventure:
